_comment: The MEASURED class of every benchmark of the model-driven set (D18, T0.11): what DiscoPoP plus the gate does on it with no model, over three independent profile draws. R = no draw reaches a verified parallel program (needs restructuring); A = the majority do (parallel as written); D = R by measurement AND a true recurrence by design (the reference solution is the sequential program). This file is campaign INPUT: E1's benchmark lists and the per-class read-out of the main comparison come from it. It replaces the guessed groups of kernel_groups.json (A/B/C, fixed 14 Sep before anything was measured), which stay only for the archived pilots and E10.
source: results/T0_instruments/T0.11_measured_classes/analysis/classes.csv (runs t0_11_classes_a/b/c, 2026-09-20/21); the eight TSVC indirect-addressing loops of the author's decision 8 from runs t0_11_probe_a/b/c (2026-09-25, results/T0_instruments/T0.11_measured_classes/runs/): 3 of 3 draws FASTER each — class A
e1_repeats_why: the claim (C1) is about R; A shows 'no harm'; D shows 'no unsafe acceptance' (record §5k)

excluded.polybench/adi: D25: 2,387 s per profile (L4); one draw only, class left undetermined

tsvc_b1_note: E1-final (2 Oct) runs E1c's population repackaged in v4 (tsvc_b1): each package takes the class its loop measured in the v3 packaging (T0.11) — the loop is the same text; E1-final's own DiscoPoP-alone arm (discopop_gate_v3) re-measures it on every trial (class R 0 of 90 verified parallel, class A 3 of 3 FASTER, class D 0 of 12). Added 3 Oct, before any E1-final read-out.
tsvc_c1_note: Packaging v5 (4 Oct): every tsvc_c1 package's class is MEASURED on the new packages — three draws of discopop_capability (t0_11_c1_a/b/c; results/T0_instruments/T0.16_clean_layout/analysis/classes/), every loop the same in 3 of 3 draws: R 30, A 8, D 4. E1-final's population keeps its classes (18 R, 3 A, 4 D). s482 is R here: DiscoPoP reports its loop Do-All in this layout, and its pragma on a loop with a `break` does not compile. ORDER-4's two kernels (t0_11_c1b_a/b/c, 3 of 3 draws no-change): k27 R; k53 D — declared decline (its two statements feed each other), R by measurement.
tsvc_c2_note: Packaging v6 (5 Oct): every tsvc_c2 package's class is MEASURED on the new packages — three draws of discopop_capability (t0_11_c2_a/b/c; results/T0_instruments/T0.17_repetition_loop_inside/analysis/classes/), every loop the same in 3 of 3. The 25 loops of E1's population have the class they have in tsvc_b1 and tsvc_c1 (R 18, A 3, D 4). Against tsvc_c1 two kernels differ: k17 and k42 (ONE repetition) are A here — DiscoPoP alone puts its pragma on the repetition loop, which has one iteration, and the gate accepts a directive that parallelizes nothing (parallel-speed-not-measurable in every draw). They are in no experiment on v6. k53 is D by declaration (a hidden cycle), as in tsvc_c1.
tsvc_c3_note: Packaging v7 (7 Oct): every tsvc_c3 package's class is MEASURED on the new packages — three draws of discopop_capability on the fixed DiscoPoP (t0_11_c3_a/b/c; results/T0_instruments/T0.18_repetitions_necessary/analysis/t018_readout.md), every package the same in 3 of 3 and the class of its tsvc_c2 package on the same DiscoPoP (t0_11_c2_b14_a/b/c): R 29, A 10, D 5. k17 and k42 (ONE repetition) are A by the rule's letter, as in tsvc_c2. Four packages are barred from experiments in which a model's program is judged for speed, because their repetitions cannot be proven necessary (meta.json repetitions_proven: false): k17, k42, s277, s424.
tsvc_c4_note: Packaging v8 (10 Oct): every tsvc_c4 package's class is MEASURED on the new packages — three draws of discopop_capability (t0_11_c4_a/b/c; results/T0_instruments/T0.19_packaging_v8/analysis/t019_readout.md), every package the same in 3 of 3: A 1 (s311), R 8. Two of the R are not R for want of a pattern or a clause: s3111 — DiscoPoP offers its sum reduction in every draw and the gate's output check refuses it (the six builds of the original agree exactly, so the output is compared byte for byte, and a reordered sum differs in the 15th digit): no setup can win it with a parallel sum, and it is in no experiment; s319 — a sum over two statements for which DiscoPoP offers nothing, although the clause is one it writes. s341 is tsvc_c2's loop on data in which elements of b cross zero between repetitions.
